segments.text: One of Lia's personal ninjas, she does all the dirty or secret jobs that Lia orders her to do. While seemingly apathetic from the outside, Kanami is actually very concerned with her ability as a ninja. It's implied that she is always training by herself to hone her skills. She longs to be a normal girl, but that's an impossible dream. Lia ordered her to keep tabs on Rance, a job that she hates since she also hates him.
She later fell in love with Rance and gave birth to his daughter, Kentou Uzume.
リーザス王女リアの直属忍者。
小柄で素早く、忍者としての力をおおいに発揮するが、
出身のJAPANの忍者の里では中忍程度。
女の色香を使う『くのいち』の技は未修得。
リア専属の忍者。
忍者としての能力はそれほど低くはないのだが、天才的な鈴女とは残念ながら比べ物にならない。
現在は、リアの命令でランスの警護という名の監視を行っているが、
過去、ちょっかいを出された事も多く、ランスの事はあまり好きではない。
リーザス王国女王の直属の忍者。
ランスがリーザス国内でのある事件を調べていた時、女王（当時は王女）リアの命令による妨害工作を仕掛けてランスと出会った。
以来、ランスにベタ惚れになってしまったリアの命令でランスの監視任務についていることが多く、だいたいはランスがいる部屋の天井裏にいる。
小柄で素早く、忍者の能力はそこそこあるのだが、本人は普通の女の子として幸せになりたいと願っている。
以前はリーザス王女直属で、今はランス専属の女忍者。
才能はあるのだが、いまいち修行が中途半端になってしまった永遠の発展途上忍。
「見当」は本当は苗字ではなく忍者として授かった別名。
リーザス王女リアに仕える忍者。
主人と任務に忠実で、冷静に行動しようと努める普通の女の子。
「最っ低……初めて会った時から思ってたけど　やっぱ最低ね……」

现任利萨斯女王莉雅的直属女忍者，mask出身于位于JAPAN关东地区的风魔忍军。在年幼的时候到大陆去游学，但在途中与朋友走散，在利萨斯被莉雅捡到后服侍于她，因此被风魔忍军视为逃忍（抜け忍）。（初期设定是在战场上为莉亚所救。）只听从莉雅的命令，负责谍报与暗杀作业。在小光诱拐事件后与兰斯成了孽缘，负责当他与女王之间的联络人。刚开始时极为讨厌与兰斯做爱，但因为莉雅的命令就是要服侍兰斯，所以无法脱离这个不幸。加奈美是兰斯十位命运中的女人（運命の女）之一。原本是一位不管任务多么困难都会泰然处之的女忍者，不过随着年纪增长开始对“普通女孩子的生活”产生憧憬。忍术方面并不大出色，但因为时常与兰斯做爱，才能限界也因此提升。如果只看才能界限，还是有十万人选一的卓越才能。伊贺忍军首领犬饲认为如果她多加努力的话可以达到中忍水准。与利萨斯红色军团副将美娜德‧西塞是好朋友。在《战国》中回到故乡JAPAN，发觉自己的忍术才能跟故乡的忍者相较之下显得微不足道。曾接受伊贺忍者首领犬饲的锻炼。在《Quest》中，接受了变成幽灵的铃女加强忍术各项才能的基础训练。/mask
喜欢穿带有青蛙 logo 的内衣。
The maid, secretary and childhood friend of Lia. Wise and tricky, she is also very devoted to Lia.
リア付きの筆頭侍女。
リアを盲目的に溺愛しており、彼女が望むことなら非人道的な行為でも進んで行うという、怖い一面を持つ。
極めて有能な人材で、リーザスを裏から実質的に支配しているのは、マリスだという噂。
リアのことを除けば、才色兼備の頼れるお姉さんである。
利萨斯首席侍女，负责王女莉亚的大小事务。
溺爱莉亚到了病态的程度。
莉亚掌权后辅助政务，职责类似于宰相。

segments.text: Lia Parapara Leazas is the recently crowned Queen of Leazas.

Her hobby used to be torturing girls, but ever since Rance punished her for it, she has been restrained from further kidnappings. She is obsessed with Rance, her love for him is so intense that she would give him the entire country if he asked. She refers to Rance as "Darling".

Leazas has prospered under her rule, even though she was recently coronated. However, many nobles hate her and her ways and have tried to take her down in the past or even go as far as assisting enemy countries.
From AliceSoft Wiki
大陸東北部に位置する大国・リーザス王国の現国王。
利益のためには容赦なく他者を切り捨てることができる、まさに王に足る素質を持つ女王……と称されているが、実際は侍女のマリスが実権を握っているともっぱらの噂。
ランスに処女を奪われてから、ランスのことを「ダーリン」と呼んで追い続けている。
陰謀渦巻く王宮で育ったためか、マリスなどの側近を除いて基本的に人を信用していない。
Ｓ属性が強く、趣味は女の子いじめ。
特にランスに近しい女性には容赦がない。
（ランスにお仕置きをされてからは控えている）。
抱いているのはライトニングドラゴンの「はるまき」
世界一豊かなリーザス王国の王女様。
父王はまだ健在だが、実質的に国の運営を取り仕切っている。
才色兼備で、優しい笑顔で国民からの評判も上々。
非の打ち所がないように見えるが……？
自幼便与其侍女玛丽斯一同参与丑陋的政治斗争，并胜出
最终让父王退位，自己坐上了女王之位
其后，她在政治、经济、外交方面大展拳脚
让利萨斯王国成为了最强王国，是一位年轻优秀的女王
养有一只幼体雷龙当宠物

One of the Four Witches of Kathtom who Rance saved during the events of Rance II. Maria was an apprentice under Ragishss, specializing in water magic. However, she lost almost all of her magical abilities after Rance took her virginity. Despite this, she compensates with her technical skills.

She's the brains behind the Tulip series of weapons and is keenly interested in firearms development. Her tireless work has propelled Kathtom to the forefront of technology on the Continent, with her inventions playing pivotal roles in conflicts such as Leazas' liberation.
She is also a close friend to her fellow witch, Masou Shizuka, as they were studying magic together and being taught by the same person, Ragishss.
Edited from AliceSoft Wiki
元カスタム四魔女のひとり。
現在はカスタムにあるマリア工場の責任者。
優秀な科学者であり、ヒララ鉱石から強力なエネルギーを生み出す。
チューリップシリーズの発明者。
元カスタム四魔女の一人。
天才科学者にして、射撃兵器・チューリップシリーズの発明者。
志津香とは親友。
ランスのことが好きだが、シィルへの遠慮や決して独占することができないランスのことについて、常に悩み続けていた（最近では吹っ切れてきたようである）。
恋におよび腰な眼鏡っ娘。
自由都市カスタムに住む、元魔法使いで現発明家。
過去の事件でランスとは知り合い。
「はっはー！　どうよ！　チューリップ1号の前には、剣と魔法の戦争なんて時代遅れなのよ！」
元カスタム四魔女の一人。水の使い手。魔導師ラギシスの私塾で育てられたが、フィールの指輪によって力を失った魔法使い*1。才能はAクラス。
力を失ってからは本来好きだった機械工作や研究活動に没頭し、その類まれな才能を開花させる。世界の常識を覆す様々な兵器(チューリップシリーズ)等を開発し続けている天才技術者。兵器開発以外にも、学術的興味をかき立てるような事柄への好奇心は非常に強い。メインウェポンはチューリップ1号。
A powerful magic user who was one of the Four Witches of Kathtom. According to her teacher, Ragishss, Shizuka had the greatest talent of the four and was considered the strongest among his students.

With the additional power gained from her ring, she became even stronger than Ragishss Cryhausen, whom she ended up killing during her betrayal. She is very concerned with her father's death. Ever since Rance stopped her from altering the past during the events of the Kathtom Incident, she has been trying to find her father's killer in order to seek revenge.

Despite the fact that Shizuka is one of ten girls who are fated for Rance, she hates Rance and will always try to kick him away whenever possible. But it appears that she still have some kind of soft spot for him, albeit often misused by the latter.
She was living with her best friend, Maria, as they were studying magic together and had a similar interest in magic, with Maria being on development side, and Shizuka on the research side.
From AliceSoft Wiki
カスタム防衛隊隊長。元カスタム四魔女のひとり。
魔法使いとしてはAランクに位置する。
マリアとは仲がよく、一緒に旅行に出かける。
父の仇ラガールを捜している。
技術都市カスタムの守護者・カスタム四魔女の
元リーダーにして、大陸屈指の天才魔法使い。めちゃくちゃ強い。
人をあまり信用しない性格だが、唯一の親友であるマリアには心を許している。
ランスの事が好きなマリアを放っておけず、毎回行動を共にしては、ランスに振り回されることに……。
ランスには未だに心を許していない。
というより、「毎度迷惑をかけられまくりのランスはぶっちゃけ大嫌い」らしい。
自由都市カスタムに住む、高レベルの魔法使い。
過去の事件でランスとは因縁があり、嫌っている。
クールなようで激情家。
「これはカスタムの問題よ、あんたに頼るつもりはない」
自由都市地帯カスタム出身の魔法使い。
mask幼少の頃から数年前まで、父を殺し母をさらった男、
ラガールへの復讐心にとらわれて生きていた。
ラガールの死後、その娘であり、志津香の異父姉妹でもあるナギ
・ス・ラガールに恨まれ、今度は自分が復讐を誓われてしまう。
現在は、妹を倒すことをよしとせず、たびたび来るナギの襲撃を
かわして居所を転転とする日々を過ごしている。
ランスのことは大嫌いだと言っているが、結局行動を共にする
ことが多い腐れ縁。/mask
Rick Addison is the commander of the Leazas Red Corps.

He's the strongest Swordsman in Leazas, one of the strongest people on the continent and is known across the land for his fearful strength, he has been nicknamed the "Red Death of Leazas" by his enemies.
The kanji 忠 written on his helmet means "loyalty". Underneath that helmet is a surprisingly boyish and shy face.
From AliceSoft Wiki
リーザス王国赤の軍将軍。
斬り込み部隊である赤の軍を率いて先陣を切る最強の騎士。
戦場での壮絶な強さから「リーザスの赤い死神」として国外でも知られている。
パットンが指揮をとったヘルマンのリーザス侵攻の際にランスと知り合い、以降、女王リアの命令で何度かランスの冒険を手助けしている。
今回もリアの命令を受け、お忍び参戦。
リーザスの正規軍、赤の軍の将軍にして、リーザス最強の剣士。
控えめで誠実な、模範的な騎士だが、戦闘狂のケがある。
ヘルマン軍の奇襲を受け、現在生死不明。
「ヘルマンを討ちます。――――突撃！」

率领利萨斯第三军“红色军团”（赤の軍）的第十三代将军。同时也是里萨斯最强的剑士，等级与才能限界都是利萨斯最高，在大陆上也是屈指可数的强者，被称作“利萨斯的红色死神（リーザスの赤い死神）”。使用红色的魔法剑拜罗德（バイ・ロード）时，能使用光属性的必杀技拜拉威（バイ・ラ・ウェイ）。佩戴的头盔上刻有“忠”字，与其爱剑一样，由历代的红将军代代传承。虽被称为“利萨斯的红色死神”，但面具之下是个充满稚气的脸孔。 一旦取下头盔露出弱气的面庞时，便会变得非常害怕妖怪以及魔物，是极少数人知道的唯一弱点。本人曾经说过，当他带上头盔以后就会涌现出不思议的勇气，变得无所畏惧。在《鬼畜王》中，瑞克若是与莱拉开始交往，便会克服这个弱点。平时是个寡言少语、礼仪周全、富有常识，个性正直的男子，但在进入战斗之后便会浮出凶猛的笑容，变得危险而好战，兰斯甚至不想与这样的瑞克交手。擅长战争，但对迷宫战相当苦手。跟讨厌男性的兰斯具有良好的关系，对玛莉丝怀有好感。尽管被蕾拉所喜欢，本人却不是很有感觉，但在《战国》中，玛莉亚曾表示看到过两人约会的场景。

Feliss is originally a 6th Class Devil, currently binded by contract with Rance. Ever since meeting the latter, she experienced misfortunes and was demoted several times. Mainly providing service in battlefield and in bed, she also serves as Rance's personal informant and as events occur, provides important information that would otherwise be unbeknownst to him.
From AliceSoft Wiki
悪魔（階級は、第7級魔神）です。
本来なら人類がもっとも恐れる存在であるが、ランスに真の名を知られた事により、
ランスの命令には絶対に逆らえない状況にされている。ほとんどランスの使い魔として便利に扱われている。
それも呼び出されては、何をするでなくセックスの相手をさせられるだけだっりして哀れな事このうえない。
カラー時代、ちょっと不良娘だったため悪魔となった。
根は真面目だったので悪魔の仕事も誠実にこなし第六階級まで駆け上がったが、ランスに出会ったことで坂を転がるように人生を転落させていった。
mask原本为卡拉，因为学坏而/mask在22岁时成为恶魔。

在《II》中，菲莉丝偶然被兰斯以“恶魔契约”召唤，mask以死后付出灵魂为契约（Deal with the Devil）代价要兰斯许下三个愿望，结果兰斯许了两次愿望之后，第三次愿望以“让整个契约无效”，结果让菲莉丝没办法与兰斯完成契约而被从六级恶魔贬为九级，并被分派为‘恶魔洞窟’的门卫，遇上前来洞穴寻找物件的兰斯。第一次将兰斯赶跑，第二次由于兰斯事先已经得知她的本名，从此成为兰斯随时差遣与泄欲的使役魔。
在《5D》中，菲莉丝被兰斯在月事来的日子强奸，怀孕生下黑暗兰斯（ダークランス），因此触犯恶魔界禁律“与人类产子”，遭受生产300只恶魔与严刑拷问的惩罚，结果导致精神受创。脱逃之后，与儿子四处流浪。参 3后在《QUEST》中被兰斯接回兰斯城居住。/mask
ランスの使い魔。
ちょっと不良ちゃんだったので22歳の時に悪魔化した元カラーの女の子。
おふだを持ったランスに半ば偶然召喚された。悪魔のくせに人が良い上に騙されやすく、それも祟って悪魔界一不幸な悪魔。ちなみにランスが初契約成立の相手らしい。
ランスの願いをかなえたは良いが、騙されて契約を破棄された為に第6階級から第9階級に降格させられた。ランスが原因で本当に悲惨な目にあった数少ない例。
maskが、さすがにランスも、ランスクエスト・マグナムでの再会時は、フェリスに負い目を感じているようで、彼によってランス城地下に匿われた事で、何とか平穏な生活は送れている。ただし、導く者の騒動で、ランスとの間に生まれた息子であるダークランスとは生き別れ状態になっている。/mask

Athena 2.0 is an artificial humanoid lifeform part of the Athena Series, created by Frostvine using magic and the essence of a devil and an angel. She's basically an orange-haired organic magical android that serves as a pet to Rance, aiding him when adventuring and serving as some sort of watchdog for his house. She was originally created to be the ultimate toy for a child after the original, Athena 1.0, ended up being too human-like and ran off with a Ham Bambara monster.
From AliceSoft Wiki
魔女フロストバインが作った人工生命体。
構成されている材料に若干問題があったのか少し変？
人間に近づく為の実地研修という形でランスの元に預けられているが、
なんの成長もせずにランスとエッチしたり近所の子供と遊んだり
日々楽しそうに暮らしている。
大魔女フロストバインが生み出した
人工生命体あてなシリーズの第2号。
ランスに懐いておりペットのような存在。
今は自由都市アイスのランス宅でお留守番中。
魔女フロストバインによって生み出された究極の人工生命体……のはずが、材料にランスの精液が
混じったためか少々おつむが足りない。
失敗作なんかじゃないのれす

イラーピュに住んでいた魔女フロストバイン謹製の人工生命体。人間に可能なことは全て可能な万能ぶりを見せる。戦闘力が高くHもできるが、制作材料にランスの体液が混ざったため、設計と異なり頭が致命的に弱い。しかしながら、性格は素直かつ従順で、「ご主人様」であるランスのことが大好きである。また、日常生活において役には立たないが、冒険となると、非常に高い戦闘能力だけでなく寸分も狂わぬ正確なマッピング機能、電卓いらずの演算機能、暗闇も平気な望遠鏡のような等、色々と役に立ってくれる。また、あらゆる声真似も可能。試作品の運用テストということでランスに預けられる前にヴァージョンUPもしており、ランスの要望で乳首追加（あてなver2.01）ランスの要望でアソコ追加（あてなver2.02）
現在はランス家の居候で、普段はシィルの手伝いもせず近所の子供と遊んでいる。ムシ大好きでちょっとSMちっくな変態エロが好き。お酒では酔っぱらわないが、カキピーを食べると酔う。
Leila is the leader of the Royal Guards of Leazas, entirely composed of female soldiers.

Leila is an elite fighter. She won the female division of swordsmanship championships of Leazas at the age of 14, and won 7 following consecutive years. She used to consider allowing only strong men to sleep with her, and has had sex with her sword master Jiba at age of 16 and warrior named Kobayashi at age of 20. However, ever since she realized her feelings towards Rick, she has been restraining herself. She's also encouraged others to confess before, saying that they have to take the chance now that they are young.

She's usually very depressed after losing and drowns her sorrows in alcohol. She likes drinking but only takes it too far when she's depressed. When she's drunk she tends to do things that normally would embarrass her, but luckily she forgets everything the following day.
From AliceSoft Wiki
大陸一の絢爛と謳われる、リーザスの親衛隊の隊長。
リックに次ぐ剣腕を持つ、頼れるお姉さん。
リーザス城陥落の際に応戦していたが、現在生死不明。
「かなみさん。あなたは……逃げて。　逃げて、あなたの任務を全うして」

Milli appears as both a tough warrior and glamourous girl in daily life but she also can be quite affectionate at times, especially when it comes to her sister, Mill, even to the extent that she dares to enter a dangerous labyrinth just for her.

She has a massive appetite for sex and, needless to say, gets along with Rance well because of it (though he doesn't like the fact that she's always the one dominating him when they're at it). She's also bisexual. She lives primarily as an adventurer and warrior but somehow also runs a pharmacy with her sister.

Her file in Kichikuou Rance says: "Most of her subordinates, whether man or woman, have been raped by her. Possibly because of that, she has good leadership over them. People tend to call her unit Queen Milli and her slaves".

She's also pretty much the most powerful mage in the human realm, being one of the few beings with a Lv3 skill in magic. During her stay in Helman, she met Thoma Lipton, Helman's strongest soldier, and Paelina, at the time the emperor newest concubine. Hunty and Paelina became friends rather quickly. However, after Paelina's sudden death, Hunty promised to take care of her son, "Patton" and turn him into a great man.

With the passing of time a special relationship started to be formed between Patton and Hunty, one that would later become love. She helped the rebellion in Helman, hoping to turn Patton into the new emperor.

A fearsome warrior known throughout the land, not just for his impressive battle skills but also for his shameless womanizing ways. While he's driven more by his primal instincts than noble ideals, his actions often result in unexpected heroism.

Even though he's rough around the edges, Rance often ends up doing good deeds on his many adventures, even if he doesn't intend to. His exploits are varied, including battling fearsome demons, standing against rival nations, and even helping out those in distress.

Unironically, Rance's disorderly conduct frequently lands him in hot water. His relentless chase of carnal indulgences tends to create more facepalm moments than applaudable ones, adding to his already infamous reputation.

On his frequent adventures, Rance is not a lone wolf. He is often accompanied by a cast of unique characters who add their own spice to the narrative. However, these companions, notably his enslaved romantic interest Sill Plain among others, often find themselves grappling with his audacious behavior. Despite the hurdles, this diverse crew manages to unite their skills, forming a solid team crucial to their shared escapades.

segments.text: Fletcher Modell is the former general of the Helman Third Army and one of the most famous and important figures of the Military Country.

フロストバインの小間使い。ランスを先生と呼ぶ。
黒髪に青と金のオッドアイの女の子だが正体は何十年も生きてる化け猫。地味なメイド服姿で蓮葉口調。
浮遊都市イラーピュの南の塔でフロストバインの研究を手伝いながら生活していた。小間使いとなった経緯は不明だが、シリーズを通して主従漫才を続けており、フロストバインも「出来の悪い孫のようなもの」と憎からず思っている。タマも小間使いの立場でありながら平然と暴言を吐けるほど阿吽の仲。
旧シリーズでは「たま」と平仮名表記であったが、新シリーズからは「タマ」と片仮名に変更された。
猫なので発情期がある。

Julia Lindum is a member of the Leazas Royal Guard, formed from the strongest women within the military and dedicated to protecting the Royal Family. Unfortunately, Julia didn't attain the rank of Royal Guard due to her strength but instead because of her family's connections.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Willis Fujisaki is the personal Level God of the great adventurer and Lord of the Rance Castle, Rance, and has been acting as his personal assistant to raise his Levels over the course of his many adventurers.
From AliceSoft Wiki
Eleanor Ran was one of the apprentices of the mage Ragishss and at one time known as one of the Four Witches of Kathtom. Her specialties as a warrior are illusion, mind control, and swordsmanship.
From AliceSoft Wiki

cast.characterName: ラルガ・サッキュバス
cast.originalCharacterName: ラルガ・サッキュバス

segments.text: Ralga is a Rare Gal Monster taking control over Shizuka's maze in her absence during the events of Rance 02. She employs Gal Monsters called Catgirls to guard her mansion from intruders, which she renames "Ralga Cats".
From AliceSoft Wiki

cast.characterName: バレス・プロヴァンス
cast.originalCharacterName: バレス・プロヴァンス

segments.text: Supreme commander of Leazas' military forces and acting general of its largest unit the Black Army.
A veteran knight who has served the royal family for three generations, he is wholly devoted to serving his country and is valued greatly for his excellence as a military leader.

Despite his high rank within Leazas, Rance does not even slightly respect Barres, and generally bullies him whenever they are forced to interact with each other. Nonetheless, Barres carries a deep respect for Rance's abilities as a leader, and is largely oblivious to his hatred of him, resulting in him getting picked on even more.
From AliceSoft Wiki

The official mascot of Alice Soft. A polite young girl who often communicates with the player as a medium in some Alice Soft games. She sometimes represent marketing upcoming Alice Soft games in trailers and advertisements.
She is accompanied by her pet black crow named Yukichi.
Io Ishtar is part of the small Helman expedition to Ylapu under the command of Bitch Golch, along with Merim Tser, Hubert Lipton, and Dens Blau.

Io has spiky silver hair and silver eyes. She has a mischievous personality, making a habit of saying ridiculous lies to get a rise out of others and see them panic. She highly enjoys sexual activity, being one of the few women who can go several rounds with Rance and compete with him for dominance. She is bisexual and also seems to harbor some sadism as she abused Sill in Rance IV.
Her attitude is mostly carefree and she tends to take things casually at her own pace.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Atlanta is a mage and is skilled with many curses and spells. Her most iconic curse is the one that traps her opponent in a Mirror and divides it into several fragments. Those trapped in it cannot get out and their only hope is that someone else finds all the mirror pieces. Once they are all gathered and put together, the victim will be released immediately.

Atlanta is an Apostle of Lexington first (chronologically) seen in Rance IV and later seen in every iteration of the Toushin Toshi series up to date. She's travelling all over The Continent carrying the Demonic Blood Soul of her master searching for a way to bring him back, but she's not very competent, since she's spent a few centuries with no success.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Kasumi K. Kasumi is Maria Custard's assistant and student. She usually appears in scenes where Maria is working on Tulip. Like her teacher she's clumsy but very loyal and faithful. She's very shy and innocent, and brushes aside Rance's advancements on her. She's the Deputy Director of the Maria Factory and is in charge of the management and administrative affairs. Her clothes and looks are similar to Maria but has a short black hair instead.
From AliceSoft Wiki
Kiseda Espira is the leader of the Youth Brigade, a community organization designed to protect and maintain the peace of Toushin City.
From AliceSoft Wiki
Freoncoise is the owner of the Yum Yum Diner restaurant on the floating island of Ylapu.
She is one of the oldest residents of the small city and served as something of an unofficial leader for the small town.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Cynthia is a priestess from Toushin City born on the floating island of Ylapu. She's the older twin sister of Alicia, and the two are part of the small Younashi Church that formed on the Toushin Toshi.
Cynthia is much more devoted to the God Younashi as her sister. The two don't get along well but they still seem to hold some affection for the other.

Alicia is a priestess from Toushin City born on the floating island of Ylapu. She's the younger twin sister of Cynthia, and the two are part of the small Younashi Church that formed on the Toushin Toshi.
Alicia is nowhere near as devoted as Cynthia is to the God Younashi and her sister considers her a delinquent. The two don't get along well but they still seem to hold some affection for the other.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Bitch Golch is an individual from a prestigious family from Helman and one of its most important political figures, being a member of the Council of Eight. Despite this, he only got to this position due to his family's influence, by trickery and cheating. He lacks any type of talent or skills in politics or military at all, and heavily abuses his position. He is cruel and narcissistic, looking down on others and blaming them for his own mistakes.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Merim Tser is the younger daughter of the Tser family and the long-lost little sister of Captain Ruberan. Born into a poor household in the economically unstable Helman Empire, her parents were unable to sustain the entire family and Merim was eventually sold as a slave to the Aristocratic Golch Family, being separated from her older sister as a result. As the personal slave of Bitch Golch, Merim experienced a great deal of abuse and mistreatment. She was used to serve him and his family as a maid, a sexual outlet, and experienced heavy torture due to the family's sadism (who often enjoyed whipping her).

Despite all the horrible things she went through with the Golch Family, she was given the opportunity to study and learn a lot about archeology, history, and mechanics. This lead to her becoming a great explorer and archaeologist due to her natural talent and enthusiasm for learning.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Mikan is a blonde apprentice level goddess under Willis Fujisaki that made her first appearance in Rance IV. Being an apprentice, her chances of success at leveling up Rance's party was originally nil, causing Rance to either lose all of his current experience, triple his current experience or power up his weapon. Since Rance was the first character to be evaluated for level up, he was the only member who was ever affected by her failures.
From AliceSoft Wiki
Doctor Moganda is a very short man and look quite human for a tousho with a head like a turnip. He cares little for people and sees them as little more then experiments.
From AliceSoft Wiki

A Level God that has appeared in multiple different Alicesoft titles, acting as the personal Level God of a different character in most of them. He is a handsome man that dresses in blue clothing that resembles the kind worn by a jester, and carries a deck of playing cards with him at all times.

He is a laid back and smooth-talking man who believes that love is not limited by gender. As a result of this, he acts equally flirtatious towards both male and female clients, and refers to everyone he serves as "Sweet Honey" regardless of their gender. He generally serves as the personal Level God of women, but he has no problems with acting as one to a man.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Dio Calmis is a Tousho that slept in the floating land of Ylapu, which in reality is the Toushin Toshi linked to Toushin Upsilon. He claimed to be the strongest Tousho ever made and was sealed due to being too dangerous and violent. Prior to his transformation, when Dio was still human, he was a notorious assassin with incredible fighting skills; the mere mention of his name was enough to strike fear. Dio was a sadistic and cruel individual that took great pleasure from killing.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Dens Blau is a common soldier of the Helman 2nd Army who serves as a member of Bitch Golch's exploration party on the floating city of Ylapu in Rance IV. The team is tasked gaining control of the floating island in order for it to be used as a weapon by the militaristic nation.

Throughout his time on Ylapu, Dens was far more focused on providing emotional comfort to his friend Hubert Lipton, who was in the process of grieving the apparent deaths of both his father Thoma Lipton and his best friend Patton Misnarge than he was in assisting Bitch in his mission. While Dens provided ample muscle and formidable fighting ability while exploring the floating city, particularly during his group's various conflicts against the Rance Rescue Team, he was unwilling to assist Bitch in performing his most depraved actions, to the point of freeing Masou Shizuka from his clutches after he had captured and attempted to rape her despite her being his enemy.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Replica Misly is an old Tousho from a long forgotten age who lives deep within the floating island of Ylapu. Her mission is to guard the dormant Toushin Upsilon and prevent him from ever being activated. She carries out this mission for over 500 years.
From AliceSoft Wiki

Frostvine is an old woman who has dedicated the majority of her life to the creation of Doll Homunculi, with her most famous and important creation being the Athena Series. She is the creator of Athena 2.0 and the master of Tama the cat girl, though she can often get angry at her oft-distracted assistant. She made her first appearance in Rance 4 where she lives at the very top of one of the Ylapu towers.
From AliceSoft Wiki
King Dragon, better known by his nickname KD, is a mysterious, cat-like being who wanders blithely across The Continent, providing unusual quizzes to all who encounter him.

KD's true identity is none other than Magiihoa (マギーホア, magīhoa), the king of the Dragons; mighty beings which once served as Humanity's precursor as the Protagonist Race of the Planner Scenario. Dragon society was structured around a strength-based hierarchy, with the strongest dragons reigning over the weaker members of their race. As the dragon king, Magiihoa, a ruby dragon, was recognized as the single most powerful dragon in existence, granting him absolute authority over all others of his kind.
Edited from AliceSoft Wiki

The Hanny King is the king and father of the Haniwa race. He is universally loved by all Hannies and has his own religion called the Haniwa Temple, which almost all the members of the race are part of. He also has a dedicated fan club formed by many Haniko, which is expected from the Hanny King. He looks like a regular Hanny but is white and wears a crown and a red cape, portraying his status as the King.

Despite his weird appearance, he's mostly a noble and wise individual. He isn't naturally hostile to humans unless he has reason to be and has also shown being quite fond of some females like Julia Lindum and Rizna Lanfbitt. However, like other members of the race, he still carries some weird personality quirks like his love for silly and clumsy girls wearing glasses, which he likes the most for some reason. He also has a solid friendship with King Dragon.
From AliceSoft Wiki
Toushin Upsilon is one of the few remaining Toushin in the current era. It was deactivated many years ago and was hidden in the floating continent Ylapu, guarded by Replica Misly.
From AliceSoft Wiki

The System Goddess is a goddess who has encountered Rance in his journeys, though it is unknown if his these meetings are canon or not. She is in charge of saving, loading, and changing system options in your game.
From AliceSoft Wiki
